title: EyeWash Station Idents
summary: Six analog bumpers: Please Stand By, Rinse Cycle, Unscheduled Programming, Aspect Ratio Matters, We Always Return, 3:44 Again. One still, one sting, one Continuity Voice line each. Nobody comments on the frame.
